name: claude-code-kit
description: A small kit of Claude Code plugins: guardrails and workflows for everyday engineering.

plugins.name: quality-guard
plugins.description: Tier declaration and test-first hooks plus code quality skills (six-round protocol, TDD, consistency, pitfalls).

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review level routing, a four-reviewer pull request review, design review, REVIEW.md tooling and read-only reviewer agents.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Skills and templates for open topics, postponed work, lessons and decisions: topic tracking, enhancement list, pattern capture, decision lookup and index.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Ship, land, branch checks, safe-git rules, a ship reminder and default git conventions.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Wrap up a session, resume where you left off and check what to do next, driven by a progress file.

plugins.name: lookup
plugins.description: Look things up properly: code that fits your installed library version, information from primary sources with dates, sources and what was not confirmed.
